column4: Kernel is a one-line forwarder to MiAllocateUserPhysicalPages. Sogen writes 0 to number_of_pages and returns STATUS_NOT_SUPPORTED. AWE physical page mapping is not emulated — this stub is the correct behavior.
Kernel forwards to MiAllocateUserPhysicalPages passing the extended flags. Sogen mirrors NtAllocateUserPhysicalPages: clears page count, returns STATUS_NOT_SUPPORTED. Consistent.

Kernel delegates to NtCreateTimer2 with TimerType=2 (interrupt-rate). Sogen writes a null handle and returns STATUS_SUCCESS. Null handle is the expected out-param when timer type is unsupported.
Kernel calls PsCreatePartition. Memory partitions are a Hyper-V isolation primitive not modeled in single-process emulation. Null handle + STATUS_SUCCESS stub correct.

Kernel calls KeGetCurrentThread()->PreviousMode then KeTestAlertThread and returns STATUS_ALERTED (0x101) if alert pending, else 0. Sogen calls yield_thread(true) and returns STATUS_SUCCESS. The alert-delivery mechanism is different but the observable result (thread yields cooperatively) is acceptable for the single-threaded emulator cooperative scheduler.

Kernel calls IopUnloadDriver with force=0. Driver unloading not applicable. STATUS_SUCCESS stub correct.
Kernel calls ExpNtUpdateWnfStateData with ExplicitScope=1. WNF not emulated. STATUS_SUCCESS stub correct.

Kernel itself already returns STATUS_NOT_IMPLEMENTED (0xC0000002=3221225474) — event pairs are deprecated in modern Windows. Sogen returns STATUS_SUCCESS which is equally non-blocking. Both are trivial; the behavioral difference (success vs not-implemented) is inconsequential for any caller that can reach this path.

Kernel initializes the MUI mutex via KiInitializeMutant and returns 1 (TRUE). Sogen returns STATUS_SUCCESS (0). This is an ntdll-internal once-init callback invoked during DLL_PROCESS_ATTACH; the return value is used by RtlRunOnceComplete internals, not by application code. The difference is benign.

Kernel calls KeBugCheckEx(0x123, 0, 0, 0, 0) — a hard BSOD. This path is only reachable if a VTL0 import is missing from the VTL1 secure kernel image, which cannot happen in user-space emulation. Sogen returns STATUS_SUCCESS as a safe unreachable-path stub.
Kernel is a thin forwarder to NtAddAtomEx. Sogen delegates to handle_NtAddAtomEx. Correct match.

Kernel: validates flags (a4&0xFFFFFFFD != 0 → STATUS_INVALID_PARAMETER), calls RtlAddAtomToAtomTable via win32k callout. Sogen reads atom string, calls add_or_find_atom. Observable: add then find returns same atom ID. Verified via misc-ops-sample test.
Kernel: type>1 → STATUS_INVALID_PARAMETER, calls ObCreateObjectEx. Sogen: type=1 creates wait_completion_packet, type=0 returns NOT_SUPPORTED. Validated via io-ops-sample.
Kernel artifact is trivial forwarder. Sogen delegates to NtCreateDirectoryObject dropping shadow and flags. Correct match for standard usage.

Kernel: validates transaction handle via CmpTransDereferenceTransaction path, delegates to CmCreateKeyCallout. Sogen drops transaction handle and delegates to NtCreateKey. Observable registry key semantics match.
Sogen.md confirms: alternate dispatch variant, delegates to handle_NtCreateKey. Kernel transaction path unemulable; non-transacted key creation matches.

Kernel calls MiCreateSectionCommon then processes extended_parameters. Sogen drops extended_parameters and delegates to NtCreateSection. Standard section creation works correctly per section-sample tests.
Kernel calls IopXxxControlFile with IOCTL variant flag=1. Sogen routes to device->execute_ioctl. Both reset event on entry. Observable IOCTL dispatch behavior matches.
Kernel: probes UNICODE_STRING, calls IoRaiseHardError for display. Sogen: calls on_debug_string callback. Observable: debug string output. No testable display state in emulator context.
Kernel calls win32k callout; returns STATUS_OBJECT_NAME_NOT_FOUND on miss. Sogen calls find_atom, returns STATUS_OBJECT_NAME_NOT_FOUND on miss. Verified via misc-ops-sample NtFindAtom not found test.
Kernel artifact: thin forwarder to NtOpenKeyTransactedEx. Sogen: delegates to NtOpenKey. Both produce same observable key-open behavior.
Kernel: validates transaction via ObReferenceObjectByHandle, calls CmOpenKey. Sogen drops transaction, delegates to NtOpenKey. Non-transacted open behavior matches; transaction validation unemulable.
Sogen.md confirms: alternate dispatch variant delegating to NtOpenKeyTransactedEx. Behavior identical to NtOpenKey for non-transacted case.

Kernel calls MiReadWriteVirtualMemory with extra flags param. Sogen delegates to NtReadVirtualMemory dropping flags. Standard memory read behavior verified via section-sample ReadWriteProcessMemory test.
Kernel: ObReferenceObjectByHandle then KeClearEvent. Sogen: validates handle → event, writes previous state, clears signaled. Verified via sync-sample Event reset test.

Kernel: ObReferenceObjectByHandle then KeSetEvent with priority boost. Sogen: validates handle, sets signaled=true. Boost priority unemulable; observable event signaling matches. Verified via sync-sample Event set/wait test.
